hebrewText: זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַ/בָּ֑יִת עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ֠/הָר כָּל גְּבֻל֞/וֹ סָבִ֤יב סָבִיב֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֔ים הִנֵּה זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַ/בָּֽיִת

tokens.kjv: hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus.

tokens.bdb: a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch
a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
